d: The Supreme Court has dismissed Tamil Nadu’s plea seeking an additional 11.719 TMC of Cauvery water from Karnataka. While Karnataka argued that it was facing water distress following a failed monsoon, the verdict has triggered a political row in Tamil Nadu, with the DMK criticising Chief Minister Vijay and the TVK government over its handling of the dispute. The Hindu’s Senior Associate Editor T. Ramakrishnan discusses the court’s reasoning, the implications for the TVK government and possible ways to strengthen the Cauvery Water Management Authority to resolve the dispute.
